name: Stellar 70 Refractor
shortDescription: A friendly first telescope for bright lunar and planetary views.
description: The Stellar 70 pairs a crisp 70 mm objective with a stable alt-azimuth mount, making first observations simple without sacrificing optical clarity.

images.alt: Stellar 70 refractor telescope on an alt-azimuth tripod

name: Orion 114 Tabletop Reflector
shortDescription: A compact reflector with generous aperture for backyard deep-sky sessions.
description: Set the Orion 114 on a sturdy table and sweep through star clusters, nebulae and lunar detail with an intuitive rotating base.

images.alt: Orion 114 reflector telescope on a compact tabletop base

name: Nomad 80 Travel Scope
shortDescription: Packable wide-field optics for campsites, eclipses and road trips.
description: A short-tube 80 mm refractor with a padded carry case and lightweight tripod, designed for quick setup away from city lights.

images.alt: Nomad 80 compact travel telescope with carry handle

name: Horizon Smart Telescope
shortDescription: App-guided alignment and live stacking for effortless deep-sky imaging.
description: The Horizon combines assisted navigation, a sensitive imaging sensor and automated live stacking in a portable all-in-one observing system.

images.alt: Horizon compact smart telescope on an integrated tripod

name: Trail 8×42 Binoculars
shortDescription: Weather-sealed everyday binoculars with a bright, steady field of view.
description: Balanced 8× magnification and 42 mm objectives make the Trail a versatile companion for constellations, wildlife and travel.

name: Nightwatch 10×50 Binoculars
shortDescription: High-light-gathering binoculars tuned for constellations and star fields.
description: Fully multi-coated 50 mm objectives reveal richer star fields while the tripod adapter socket supports longer observing sessions.

name: Vista 8×25 Compact Binoculars
shortDescription: Pocket-sized optics for daytime scouting and casual night-sky orientation.
description: The folding Vista weighs less than 300 grams and slips into a daypack without giving up sharp, color-neutral views.

name: Lunar Contrast Filter
shortDescription: Reduce lunar glare and reveal subtle detail near the terminator.
description: A neutral-density threaded filter that improves comfort during bright lunar observations while preserving natural color.

images.alt: Lunar contrast filter in a round protective case

name: Plössl Eyepiece Set
shortDescription: Three versatile focal lengths for low, medium and high magnification.
description: A matched set of fully coated 1.25-inch eyepieces with fold-down eye guards and labeled protective caps.

images.alt: Three Plössl telescope eyepieces in different focal lengths

name: Observer Red Light
shortDescription: Dimmable red illumination that helps preserve night vision.
description: A glove-friendly rotary control moves from a faint chart-reading glow to a brighter campsite beam without white-light surprises.

name: Alt-Azimuth Field Tripod
shortDescription: A smooth, portable support for spotting scopes and compact telescopes.
description: An aluminum field tripod with slow-motion controls, a quick-release plate and adjustable tension for balanced observing.

images.alt: Aluminum alt-azimuth field tripod with slow-motion head

name: Optics Care Kit
shortDescription: A safe cleaning set for coated lenses, eyepieces and binoculars.
description: Remove dust and fingerprints with a blower, soft brush, washable microfiber cloth and alcohol-free cleaning solution.

images.alt: Optics cleaning kit with blower, brush, cloth and solution
